create_CocoEvaluator: create a CocoEvaluator instance with ground truth COCO data and a list of IoU types to evaluate
run_CocoEvaluator_update: run the CocoEvaluator update method to process model predictions and compute per-image evaluation results
run_CocoEvaluator_accumulate_and_summari: run accumulate and summarize on the CocoEvaluator to compute and print final COCO metrics
convert_bounding_boxes_xyzwhd: convert bounding boxes from corner format to xmin ymin zmin width height depth format using convert_to_xyzwhd
prepare_COCO_detection_results: prepare model predictions into COCO detection result format with image_id, category_id, bbox, and score fields
